run_coil20_handler_processed: run coil20_handler with processed=True to import the 20-class COIL-20 dataset from a downloaded ZIP archive
run_coil20_handler_unprocessed: run coil20_handler with processed=False to import the 5-class unprocessed COIL-20 dataset from a downloaded ZIP archive
create_path_to_label_fn: create a label extraction function that parses object class IDs from COIL-20 filenames like obj1__11.png
create_gen_split: create a generator that extracts RGB images from a COIL-20 ZIP archive and yields them with labels
review_coil_20_dataset: review the coil_20_dataset DownloadableDataset configuration for the processed COIL-20 dataset with 20 classes
